newsitem.title: CUBA: Eight dead after bus hits horse on Cuban highway.
newsitem.headline: Eight dead after bus hits horse on Cuban highway.

text.p: A bus hit a horse on a major Cuban highway early on Wednesday and then plunged into a marsh, killing eight people and injuring more than 20, officials said.

The bus was travelling from Havana to Las Tunas in the east of the island. It hit the horse near Aguada de Pasajeros, about 85 miles (140 km) southeast of the capital, according to the national news agency AIN.
The vehicle then plunged 20 feet (6 metres) into a marsh, said the national news agency AIN.
